Sound familiar?

It isn’t a lack of love. It’s a pattern.

  • When they go quiet, you reach harder, and they pull further away.
  • The relationships that feel calm also feel a little flat.
  • You know your attachment style, and the pattern still repeats.
  • You lead with confidence at work, then second-guess every text at home.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll explore in 60 minutes

Why the push and pull happens

How anxious and avoidant patterns pull on each other, explained simply, so you can spot the dance while it’s happening.

Why distance isn’t always rejection

What space can mean to a partner who needs it, and how to stop reading every pause as the end.

Spark or safety: you don’t have to choose

The idea at the heart of my new book: security doesn’t have to mean boring, and excitement doesn’t have to mean anxiety.

A creative exercise to map your pattern

A short, guided drawing exercise that shows you what words often can’t. No art skills needed, just paper and a pen.

How to ask for closeness without chasing

Simple ways to say what you need so the conversation brings you closer instead of starting another round.

Meet Briana

Hi, I’m Briana

I’m a relationship coach, art therapist and author based in New York, with more than 20 years of experience and 6,000 clients behind me.

I help professional women build secure relationships through attachment, creativity and communication. My new book, Secure in The Spark: A Spiritual Path To Heal Attachment Wounds, is about exactly what this class is about: keeping the spark and feeling safe at the same time.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Is this therapy?

No. Secure in the Spark is a coaching and education class. It isn’t therapy and isn’t a substitute for it.

Do I need to be in a relationship?

No. The class is just as useful if you’re dating, partnered or taking a break and want to understand your pattern first.

I’m not artistic. Is the exercise for me?

Yes. Stick figures and scribbles are perfect. The point is what you notice, not how it looks.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. Everyone who signs up gets the replay.

Coaching and education, not therapy.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-head scripts, 30 to 45 seconds each, filmed the way you already film your reels.

Script 1 · “Distance”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“When a partner pulls away, it doesn’t always mean what it feels like it means.”

Body

“Some people need a little space to feel safe enough to come closer again. When that space gets read as rejection, one person reaches, the other retreats, and the push and pull begins. Once you can see the pattern, you can start to change the dance.”

CTA

“I’m teaching the whole thing in a free live class called Secure in the Spark. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, on-screen text “distance” in pink italic, the way your grid posts look.

Caption line: Coaching and education, not therapy.

Script 2 · “Spark or safety”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You don’t have to choose between a relationship that feels exciting and one that feels safe.”

Body

“So many thoughtful, successful women believe security means settling for boring. My new book, Secure in the Spark, is about having both: a relationship that feels safe and still feels alive.”

CTA

“I’m sharing how in a free 60-minute class. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: holding your book to camera, cut to you talking in your office.

Caption line: Coaching and education, not therapy.

Script 3 · “Draw it”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Grab a pen. I want to show you something words often miss.”

Body

“As a relationship coach and art therapist, I’ve learned that a pattern can be easier to see on paper than to explain out loud. A simple drawing can show who reaches, who steps back, and where the space sits between you. No art skills needed.”

CTA

“We’ll do this exercise together in my free live class. Tap Sign up to join me.”

Shot: overhead of your hands sketching two circles and arrows, then back to camera.

Caption line: Coaching and education, not therapy.
